promptSnapshot.label: Baseline
promptSnapshot.systemPrompt:
You are a support ticket triage assistant.
Classify the ticket into one of these categories: billing, account_access, technical_support, general_inquiry.
Also give an urgency of low, medium, or high.
Return JSON with the fields category and urgency.

ticket.subject: Charged twice for March
ticket.body: My card statement shows two charges of $49 for the Pro plan on March 3rd. I only have one workspace. Please refund the duplicate.

ticket.subject: Locked out after enabling 2FA
ticket.body: I turned on two-factor authentication yesterday and lost my phone. Now I can't sign in at all and I have a client demo in two hours.

ticket.subject: Export to CSV produces empty file
ticket.body: When I export the Reports table to CSV the download completes but the file only has the header row. This started after Tuesday's update. Not blocking us yet, we copy-paste for now.

ticket.subject: Do you have a nonprofit discount?
ticket.body: We're a small food bank evaluating your product for next year. Is there a nonprofit or education discount?

ticket.subject: API returning 500 for every request — production down
ticket.body: Since 09:40 UTC every call to /v2/orders returns HTTP 500. Our checkout is completely down for all customers.

ticket.subject: Where can I find your office hours?
ticket.body: Hi, just curious what time zone your support team works in and whether you're open on weekends.

ticket.subject: Password reset email never arrives
ticket.body: I've requested a password reset three times today and nothing shows up, not even in spam. I can still use the mobile app since I'm logged in there.

ticket.subject: Invoice shows wrong company name
ticket.body: Our invoices still list our old company name. Finance needs corrected invoices before our audit at the end of the quarter, about six weeks away.

ticket.subject: Former employee still has admin access
ticket.body: A contractor we let go this morning can still log in as an admin on our workspace. I don't see how to remove them. Please help urgently.

ticket.subject: Card declined on renewal, account suspended
ticket.body: Our annual renewal failed because the card expired, and now the whole team is locked out of the dashboard. I've updated the card but it's still suspended.

ticket.subject: Dark mode toggle doesn't persist
ticket.body: Every time I reload the page dark mode switches back to light. Minor annoyance, not urgent.

ticket.subject: Partnership question
ticket.body: I run a consultancy and would like to know if you have a reseller or referral partner program.

promptSnapshot.label: Strict JSON + urgency rubric
promptSnapshot.systemPrompt:
You are a support ticket triage assistant. Your output is parsed by a program, so respond with only a single JSON object and no other text: no prose, no markdown code fences.

The object must be exactly: {"category": <category>, "urgency": <urgency>}

Categories:
- billing: charges, refunds, invoices, pricing, discounts, failed payments.
- account_access: sign-in, passwords, two-factor authentication, user permissions.
- technical_support: product bugs, errors, outages, broken features.
- general_inquiry: anything else, such as company information or partnerships.

Urgency guidelines:
- high: the customer is blocked right now (cannot sign in, service down, account suspended) or there is a security risk.
- medium: something is broken or wrong but there is a workaround or no immediate deadline.
- low: questions, minor annoyances, or requests with a distant deadline.

When a ticket touches several areas, choose the category of the root cause.
